name: What are common space-saving features in tiny home kitchens?
description: Common space-saving features in tiny home kitchens include compact appliances, pull-out pantries, vertical shelving, and multi-functional counter spaces.

mainEntity.name: What are common space-saving features in tiny home kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tiny home kitchens often feature compact appliances like apartment-sized refrigerators, two-burner induction cooktops, and convection microwave ovens. Space-saving solutions include pull-out pantries, corner drawers, vertical shelving, and wall-mounted storage for utensils. Undermount sinks create more counter space, while cutting boards designed to fit over the sink or stovetop provide additional prep areas. Fold-down tables or extendable counters can also enhance functionality without occupying permanent floor space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common space-saving features in tiny home kitchens include compact appliances, pull-out pantries, vertical shelving, and multi-functional counter spaces.
